contradictions.fact: Is the true (south) summit part of this route, or beyond its scope?

claims.says: though a June 2023 theodolite survey found the south summit is roughly 7 inches taller and is technically the true highpoint, reachable only via a short technical 5th-class scramble beyond the scope of this route
many scramblers stop at the middle summit rather than commit to it
8596 (equal to the true south summit / area elevation_ft, not the middle summit's ~8,590 ft)
elev 8596, note: 'True summit of the Chelan Mountains' highest point... exposed class 3 moves near the top'
5th class (short, unrated step near the true summit)
pitch 'Middle summit to true (south) summit', grade 'Class 4-5', lengthM 77

contradictions.why: The Overview explicitly says the technical step to the true summit is 'beyond the scope of this route,' yet the route's own header grade (rock_grade, which wins the header pill), high_point_ft, final waypoint, and pitch_detail all treat that 5th-class step and the true summit as officially part of this route's stats — a climber reading the Overview would think this route tops out at the lower, non-technical middle summit, while the header/stats say otherwise.
contradictions.internal_resolution: pitch_detail's three pitch lengths (230+150+77) sum exactly to length_m (457), showing the true-summit step is counted as part of the route's own official length/grade rather than excluded.

contradictions.fact: Is March open or closed to hiking?

claims.says: Mar-Oct (best Apr-May and fall); voluntary closure Feb 1-Mar 31 for wintering deer; also used for winter snowshoeing
Walk-in access (hiking, snowshoeing, etc.) is discouraged Feb 1 - Mar 31 to protect wintering mule deer
...Walk-in access is discouraged Feb 1 - Mar 31 to protect wintering mule deer in the Chelan Butte Wildlife Area.

contradictions.why: The season field's own start month (March) falls entirely inside the Feb 1-Mar 31 window that the same field (and access.closures/best_season) says walk-in access is discouraged for — so 'Mar-Oct' and the closure note contradict each other about whether March is open.
contradictions.internal_resolution: the closure note (Feb 1-Mar 31) is corroborated three times and is specific; the season field's 'Mar' start appears to be an off-by-one that should read 'Apr-Oct.'
